scientific_integrity: Analytic proof given in full. Finite ramp tests are supplemental and do not certify infinite-dimensional conclusions. Proven novelty is assessed against identified accessible sources only; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Strict positivity of all scalar functional coefficients, absolute summability, and convolution norm strictly below scalar functional norm are assumed. Distance and nowhere-density hold only in the fixed-weight convolution graph family, not the full bounded operator space. No claim to resolve the density-under-range-sums problem; unindexed equivalent literature remains a possibility.
title: A zero-frequency criterion for quasi norm attainment of convolution graphs on \(c_0\)
